cause.summary: The failed Node20 selector anchors short prefixes with $, but the registered top-level test titles continue beyond those prefixes; zero intended nodes are therefore selected.
registered_titles: D127c source guard accepts every reviewed arm and rejects wrong hash or source
D127c reviewed-profiler validator enforces the exact safe cProfile projection
evidence_basis: TypeScript AST parse of the exact committed App test blob found both registrations and zero parse diagnostics.
Regex evaluation against the exact registered title strings gives zero matches for the failed selector.
A prior Node20 control using the exact full profiler title passed 1 named node, showing the Node20+tsx route can register and run the intended control.
Node20 --help has --test-name-pattern, --test-reporter, and --import, but no --experimental-test-isolation option; Node22 exposes the isolation option.
